headline: Executive order about bringing back the name "Department of War" for the agency now called the Department of Defense.
what_it_does: Only the title of this order is available. The title suggests it deals with using or restoring the name "Department of War," which was the agency's name before 1947. The title alone does not show how far the change goes, such as whether it is a full legal rename or an added second name.

who_it_affects.group: Department of Defense employees and military service members
who_it_affects.how: The order appears to deal with the name of the department they work for, but the title does not show any change to their pay, duties, or benefits.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 5, 2025; the title alone does not give an effective date.
